lines.text: A special event has occurred.
Participate in the event.
Go back.
I've been searching everywhere for Belorta,
but I haven't been able to find her anywhere.
Ludmilla called everyone, except Mica, into the bamboo forest.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Have any of you seen Belorta around?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Nope, she's nowhere to be found.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Eunhwa and Vesti are even doing some excavation,

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: in hopes they might find her underground somewhere.
Is that why you came alone?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Yeah. They said they were too busy to come.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Signal and Delta think she might have been abducted,

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: so they're prepping a bunker buster.
Who could possibly abduct her here?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Beats me.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: I can't stop Signal from going off on her flights of fancy, so I came alone.
This is getting a little concerning...

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Noir and I searched high and low and didn't turn up as much as a single hair of Belorta's.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Where could she have disappeared to?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: I'm just glad Mica still thinks this is one big game of hide and seek.
... What was written in the letter Belorta left behind?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: If you don't come out

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: and play with me right this instant,

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: I'll vanish along with the wind.
... Did she actually get carried away by a gust of wind?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: That could potentially happen to you, Servant, but I don't think we have to worry about that happening to Belorta.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: If we keep dragging our feet, Mica will start to suspect something is wrong.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Let's pick up the pace and find her.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Roger that.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Maybe she dozed off somewhere?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Where do you think we should search next, Noir?

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: How about the hot spring?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: We can't afford to dilly-dally.
Rather than go it alone, I feel teaming up with someone will make the search easier.
Who should I pair up with?
Search with Blanc and Noir.
Search with Emma.
Search with Ludmilla.
Search with Mica.
I'll go ahead and team up with Blanc and Noir.
I think we'll be able to find Belorta faster if we look together.
Blanc, Noir, let's search for Belorta together.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Okay, let's do it!

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: O-okay...
Where were you planning on checking next?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: We already visited the waterfall, so we were planning on checking out the hot spring next.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: I hope she didn't slip and fall into the hot spring...
The three of us exchange loaded glances and quickly make our way to the hot spring.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Luckily, I at least don't see anyone in the pools.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Phew... thank goodness.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: I wonder where she went off to.

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.text: Zzz...

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.text: Zzzzzzzz...
From somewhere we can't see, comes the faint sound of snoring.
I go with Blanc and Noir to investigate the source of the sound.

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.text: Zzzzz...

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Oh my gosh!

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: There she is.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: I feel weak in the knees...
Belorta is leaning against a large rock near the hot spring, fast asleep.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: The rock must have obscured her, so we didn't notice her.
Let's hurry and wake her up.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Belorta, wake up!
You shouldn't be sleeping here.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Mmm...

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: ... Huh? Old-Timer?

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Wha... When did I fall asleep?

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: I was just getting ready to pull a prank.
Everyone's been looking for you.
It hasn't been long since that last incident, and then you went off and disappeared for hours,
leaving only a letter.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Jokes like these aren't very funny, Belorta.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Yeah! You saw how worried we were when you went missing before.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Yet here you are, dozing off in the middle of nowhere.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Do you realize how long we've been looking for you?
You took it a bit too far this time around, Belorta.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: I was just so bored.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: You guys have been ignoring me because you've all been too preoccupied with those stupid hot spring legends.

lines.speaker: blanc_noir
lines.text: If you were that bored, why didn't you just ask us to hang out?
They're right.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: I didn't expect you all to be so worried about me.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Of course! Why wouldn't we?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: I'm just glad that nothing bad happened.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: I'm sorry...

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: I promise it won't happen again, so can you forgive me...?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: *Sigh*

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Again, we're just happy nothing bad happened to you.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: If you're ever feeling bored again, just come to us, okay?

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Okay, I understand. I'll be sure to speak up next time.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: I really hope you all can forgive me...
First, let's inform everyone that we found Belorta,
and then we'll all spend the day together with you.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Sounds great! I'd have been bored too if I were in Belorta's shoes.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: So, what would you like to do together now, Belorta?
I'll go ahead and team up with Emma.
I think we'll be able to find Belorta faster if we look together.
Emma, let's search for Belorta together.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Sure! I was just about to go to the restaurant.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Belorta is a dyed-in-the-wool foodie,

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: so she might be hiding there having a meal.
Let's hurry on over.
After a thorough search of the restaurant,
Emma and I are unable to turn up any trace of Belorta.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Where could she have gone?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Maybe she really is hiding underground like Eunhwa and Vesti were saying...

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.text: Zzz...

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.text: Zzzz...
Somewhere we can't see, we hear the faint sound of snoring.
Emma and I go to investigate the source of the sound.

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.text: Zzzzz...

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I found her!
Phew.
Belorta curls up under one of the tables at the restaurant, fast asleep.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: No wonder we didn't see her. She was hidden under the table.
Let's hurry and wake her up.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Belorta, wake up!
Emma shakes Belorta awake.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Mmm...

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: ... Huh? Old-Timer?

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Wha... When did I fall asleep?

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: I was just getting ready to pull a prank.
Everyone's been looking for you.
It hasn't been long since that last incident, and then you went off and disappeared for hours,
leaving only a letter.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Yeah! We were all super worried!

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: What on earth were you doing here, anyway?

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: You guys have been ignoring me because you've all been too preoccupied with those stupid hot spring legends.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: I wanted to get back at you all by pranking you, but I accidentally dozed off. ♡
Belorta.
Some pranks can go too far,
and you've gone over the line with this one.
What if something bad had happened?

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Old-Timer?

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: I didn't expect you all to be so worried about me.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: It's just that I was so bored...

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Don't be too harsh on her, Commander.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: It's not like anything serious happened.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: No, Old-Timer is right. It may not have been intentional on my part, but I screwed up.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: I'm sorry for making you all worry.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Can you find it in yourselves to forgive me?♡
First, let's inform everyone that we found Belorta,
and then we'll all spend the day together with you.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Fine by me, hehe.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: You must have been awfully bored, weren't you Belorta?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I'll be sure to spend more time with you.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: So, what would you like to do together now, Belorta?
I'll go ahead and team up with Ludmilla.
I think we'll be able to find Belorta faster if we look together.
Ludmilla, let's search for Belorta together.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Okay, sure.
Where should we search?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Right here. I plan to comb over the bamboo forest more.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: If it gets late, there could be wild animals, so it'd be prudent to take a second glance.
We should proceed deeper into the forest.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Okay, let's do it.
Ludmilla and I ventured deep into the bamboo forest to find Belorta,
but she was nowhere to be seen.
What if we end up encountering a wild animal?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Then we'd be in deep trouble.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Anyway, let's keep going.

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.text: Zzz...

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.text: Zzzzz...
Somewhere we can't see, we hear the faint sound of snoring.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Hmm? Do you hear that?
Yeah. Very clear.
I went with Ludmilla to find the source of the sound.

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.text: Zzzz...

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: What made her decide to hide here?
If we hadn't ventured this far into the forest, we might have never found her.
Belorta is asleep on the ground, covered in bamboo leaves.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: It looks as if she planned on surprising some passersby.
Let's hurry and wake her up.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Belorta, wake up.
Ludmilla shakes Belorta to wake her.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Mmm...

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: ... Huh? Old-Timer? Ludmilla?

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Wha... When did I fall asleep?

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: I was just getting ready to pull a prank.

It hasn't been long since that last incident, and then you went off and disappeared for hours,
leaving only a letter.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: You guys have been ignoring me because you've all been too preoccupied with those stupid hot spring legends.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: I wanted to get back at you all by pranking you, but I accidentally dozed off. ♡

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Belorta!

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: If you ever feel bored, you should talk to us.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: What you shouldn't do is get these crazy schemes in your head and make us all worried for you.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Do you have any idea

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: how worried Mica and the others were when you last went missing?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: This supposed prank of yours is taking it a bit far, I'm afraid.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: I'm sorry...

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: I promise it won't happen again. Can you forgive me?
First, let's inform everyone that we found Belorta.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Belorta.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: I do understand your feelings,

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: but next time I would advise simply being honest and asking us to spend time with you.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Okay. I'll do that.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: It may not have been intentional on my part, but I screwed up.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: I'm sorry for making you all worry.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: At least you realize that and are acknowledging that fact.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Just don't let it happen again, please.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: I won't!

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Let's spend the rest of our day with Belorta.
I'm worried about Mica.
I should go find her.
I last saw her at the dormitory, so I should start there.
Mica?

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Old-Timer?

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Back already? Didn't you say there was something you needed to do?
It was just a short pow-wow.
I figured it'd be lonely searching for Belorta on your own, so I came to join you.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Oh my gosh, that's so thoughtful of you! Hehe.
Have you been able to find her?

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: No, not yet. I can't seem to find her anywhere.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: How is this even possible?
Mica...
I'm only asking as a precaution,
but what will you do if Belorta disappears again like last time?

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Well...
Mica seems to be lost in thought.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: It'll be okay.
What makes you so sure?

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Because I'm going to find her.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: No matter what.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: So I'm not scared of anything bad happening. Not anymore.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Anyway, I don't think Belorta is here. Should we go somewhere else...

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.text: Zzz...

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.text: Zzzz...

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Wait, I know that sound. That's Belorta's snoring!
Somewhere we can't see, we hear the faint sound of snoring.
Mica and I head towards the source of the sound.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Zzzzz...

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: I knew it! She's been here at the dormitory the entire time.
Belorta is inside the cleaning equipment closet, fast asleep.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: We wouldn't have found her in a million years.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Belorta, wake up! Belorta!

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Mmm...

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: ... Huh? Old-Timer? Mica?

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Wha... When did I fall asleep?

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: I was just getting ready to pull a prank.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Who sleeps in the middle of a game of hide and seek?

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Huh? What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Ludmilla said you were hiding, so we came to find you.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: But... what...
Belorta...!
I give Belorta a pointed look, hoping that she'll take the hint.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Oh, right!

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Yeah, I was playing hide and seek.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: You guys haven't had time to play with me because you're all so preoccupied with investigating the hot spring.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Oh no! I had no idea. I'm sorry...

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: It's okay. ♡

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: You can spend time with me now.
Let's inform everyone that we found Belorta,
so that we can all have some fun together.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Hehe! All right!

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Sounds great! ♡
And so the hunt for Belorta ends on a happy note,
as we all have a great time together until the wee hours of the night.
